last.verdict: Record AWS growth and margin were not enough; spending and slower retail sales weighed.

reasons.label: Cash burning on AI
reasons.text: Free cash flow was a $42.4B outflow over 12 months; 2026 capex stays near $220B.

reasons.label: Retail sales slowed
reasons.text: Total sales grew 12%; North America rose 6%, International 5%, partly from Prime Day timing.

reasons.label: Wide profit outlook
reasons.text: Q4 operating income guided to $28.5B-$33.5B, a wide range versus $28.1B this quarter.

story: Amazon's cloud unit has sped up, with AWS growth rising from 37% last quarter to 39% now, and profit margins keep hitting records. Yearly spending is steady near $220B, but cash is now flowing out. After July's 15% jump, the stock fell this time.

history.verdict: Investors cheered AWS's fastest growth in 18 quarters and big profit gains.

reasons.label: AWS speeds up
reasons.text: Cloud sales grew 37%, the fastest in 18 quarters, and AI and chip businesses each topped $25B yearly.

reasons.label: Profit jumps
reasons.text: Operating income rose 43% to $27.5B; AWS profit grew from $10.2B to $16.6B.

reasons.label: Spending seen as paying off
reasons.text: Yearly spending plan rose to about $220B, but investors accepted it given AWS's $496B backlog.
